calls.video_title: Get Paid Every Month Without Selling a Share
calls.thesis: Amplify CWP Enhanced Dividend Income ETF: ~30 big dividend payers (MSFT, VISA, CAT), sells options only on some stocks some of the time.
calls.base_case: Steadier price with a smaller check; fell less than the S&P 500 in every big market drop he cites.
calls.bull_case: Best pick for someone living off the checks who worries about a bad year.
calls.bear_case: Lower yield than the option-heavy funds; still gives up some upside when it sells calls.
